purpose: Quotes the live-data walk reopens on every redeploy (Pass A on the copy of live, Pass B on live), plus the newest quotes the signed-in login owns. Opaque quote ids and fixed reason codes only: never a name, file name or note. The owner approves the list once and every change; approval.record is the issue comment id or store commit of that approval.

reason_codes.generated: Has a current XLSX and PDF, so the walk downloads and hashes both.
reason_codes.draft: Not generated yet; the walk reopens the saved draft.
reason_codes.older: Created more than 90 days ago, so it was saved by an older release.
reason_codes.owner-pick: The owner chose it; the reason is in the approval record.
